name: kero
title: Kero
description: Find, focus, and create local terminal sessions in Kero. Requires the Kero app.
author: comf4rt_noise

commands.name: search-sessions
commands.title: Search Kero Sessions
commands.description: Search local Kero panes by project, session, directory, branch, or agent.

commands.name: new-session
commands.title: New Kero Session
commands.description: Create a local Kero shell session in a project or directory and open it.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('This is a Raycast extension, not an npm package. Export a reviewed Store checkout first with npm run export:store.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.publish: node -e "console.error('Do not publish the development repository. Use npm run export:store -- /path/to/store-checkout/extensions/kero, then review and push that Store branch.'); process.exit(1)"
